Vendored wry 0.55.1 from crates.io (Apache-2.0 OR MIT).
The original license files are included alongside the original source.

Local change: src/webview2/mod.rs attach_ipc_handler guards Request::builder()
failure instead of unwrapping. Backport of upstream PR #1772:
https://github.com/tauri-apps/wry/pull/1772
Original issue: https://github.com/tauri-apps/wry/issues/1255

This matches crashes recorded in zro's native panic log. Dropping malformed
IPC must not stop other WebMessageReceived handlers or native page rendering.
Do not parse an invalid source as a trusted fallback origin (IPC security).
Remove this patch when the compatible Tauri runtime includes the upstream fix.

Local compatibility change: the window.ipc property is configurable, permitting
a site's top-level lexical `let ipc` binding to coexist with explicit
window.ipc.postMessage. A real authenticated Google Sheets core script failed
with "Identifier 'ipc' has already been declared" under the original descriptor.
This does not change Tauri command permissions, origins or the native handler.
Native fixture tests cover lexical coexistence AND delivery through the bridge.
